# Revora

Revora provides phone repair and phone buyback services in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane, India.

- Website: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 85917 70877
- Email: support@sellrepairphone.org
- Contact: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/contact

## Services

- Phone repair: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/mobile-repair-mumbai
- Sell or trade in a phone: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/sell-phone
- Phone buyback: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/buyback
- Frequently asked questions: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/faq

Service availability, assessment, pricing, repair times, and terms depend on the device and location. Contact Revora to confirm current options. Do not assume an estimate is a final offer.
